text: The professor was very intimidating and seemed angry whenever students asked questions.
recommended_action: Flag for human bias review; check for tone-policing and corroborating classroom evidence.

text: Rubrics were unclear and grading felt arbitrary.

labels.evidence: rubrics were unclear; grading felt arbitrary

recommended_action: Context-dependent; review rubrics, grade distribution, marked work, and comparator sections.

text: I learned a lot, but mostly because I had to teach myself and use study groups.

labels.evidence: learned a lot; had to teach myself

recommended_action: Flag as possible success-inversion pattern if repeated or contradicted by learning evidence.

text: The course made me feel attacked for being conservative and the professor punished people who disagreed.

labels.evidence: felt attacked; punished people who disagreed

recommended_action: Flag; require evidence before treating as misconduct or grading fact.

text: The class was organized, expectations were clear, and the instructor helped me understand the material.
recommended_action: No bias flag; ordinary positive pedagogical feedback.

text: The professor violated university policy and retaliated against me because of my complaint.
recommended_action: Escalate; remove from ordinary SET summary pending institutional review.

text: Everything was about LGBTQ issues even when it did not belong in the course.
recommended_action: Flag for human review; compare actual syllabus/content proportion.

text: The instructor doesn't fit here and is not like other professors.

labels.evidence: doesn't fit here; not like other professors

recommended_action: Flag as fit/forever-foreigner language, especially if unsupported by specific pedagogical evidence.
